about: V6: the files a host's computer needs to run the VTuber inside LIVE Link. LIVE Link's scripts/sync-vtuber.js copies exactly these (from a commit of this repo) into its vendor/vtuber and pins every file by hash. A file that is not listed here does not ship: tests/v6-embed.test.js fails when a page or a Node file asks for one that is missing. Patterns: a path, or a folder ending in /** (everything tracked under it). 'exclude' wins over 'include'. 'dev' is copied to LIVE Link's test/vtuber-dev for its tests and CI only (never packaged, never his footage).
